budget.note: Cumulative value preserves the communicated total of rounded per-attempt durations, including sandbox failures and lightweight diagnostics. It is not an exact common-clock measurement; old boundary 1.184097625 seconds is rounded to 1.184. Remaining margin exceeds 187 seconds.

cause: Sandbox denied ps before launcher execution; actual native codes are null; readiness observers then reached their own deadlines. No physical worker ran.

Julia cooperative request rejected valid epoch-nanoseconds parsed by TOML as Int128; synthetic 0.35-second grace also expired before exit, resulting native -15/recorder 9. Fixed Integer/range check and used 2-second Julia-only synthetic grace; real grace remains 120 seconds.

Default Julia SIGINT retained native -2 but cleanup of observed descendants made status FORCED_TERMINATION; test was corrected to require the actual signal and cleanup facts instead of one particular presentation label.

Detached-child fixture exited before ownership observation; it now waits until the child is actually observed before cancellation. This does not claim to discover descendants that escape before the first observation.

identity_note: a*40 / b*40 / c*64 identities in worker fixtures are deliberate synthetic values, not a tested Git commit or physical case; final actual source bytes are listed separately.
limitations: Normal synthetic diagnostic status and completed_maps=2 are fixture fields, not real SCF or density maps.

USER_CANCELLED/130 can coexist with forced termination of remaining owned descendants. The original control, resource and outer statuses are retained; this is not a claim of wholly signal-free shutdown.
Native Julia SIGINT was -2 with no worker receipt; explicit catch produced native/worker/recorder 1 and retained InterruptException. Neither is rewritten as a clean 130 exit.
Forced cleanup covers authenticated, previously observed owned processes. It cannot prove discovery of an unobserved descendant escaping before sampling.
Unrelated-process survival was checked by its original subprocess handle during the ignore/TERM/KILL test; the passing assertion is in the native unittest log.
Real 120/10/5-second grace settings were not consumed in these bounded synthetic tests; fixtures use shorter declared waits. No actual scientific cancellation has yet been tested.
Resource status RESOURCE_BLOCKED appears in legacy sampler receipts for forced cooperative cleanup even when the originating reason is user cancellation; the raw label is preserved.
